topic: the exact paise line must read as money
lesson: The drill panel's secondary exact line renders fromPaise() output raw, so it reads '10050136.29 exact' - a bare decimal with no currency mark and no digit grouping, directly beneath a rupee figure that has both. The confirmed statement spec fixes the money format as Indian grouping with a leading rupee mark; the exact line is the same money at finer precision, not a different kind of value, so it must carry the same treatment with the paise retained - the statement's own grouping logic applied to the whole-rupee part with the two paise digits kept. Label it plainly ('exact' as a caption beside the value, not trailing prose).
